messages:
Maria Chen: Heads up — competitor X shipped streaming embeddings + on-device caching. Important to decide if we chase parity or double down on our 'predictable cost' differentiator. Thoughts?
Chris Patel: parity would need sharded KV + streaming changes. Rough estimate: 3 sprints for infra + 1 for e2e tests. Risk: rollout complexity :warning:
Sarah Gómez: we have two enterprise deals asking specifically for streaming embeddings and lower tail latency. Without parity we might lose them. They asked for launch in Q2.
Devon Li: streaming embeddings interacts with current batching/kv cache. We can prototype a 'compat' path that doesn't break default batching. Spike: 2wk to validate throughput and memory.
Albert Novak: UX-wise, streaming embeddings means new progress states in the console and different billing UI. Low effort tweaks but needs product sign-off.
Maria Chen: @Chris @Devon can we get a concrete tradeoff table? cost-to-implement vs perf gains vs customer revenue risk. Also define launch criteria (SLOs, perf benchmarks, rollout plan).
Chris Patel: I'll draft tech tradeoffs. Quick list:
- Full parity (sharded streaming): +best perf, -large infra change, ~3 sprints
- Compatibility layer: +faster, -some latency gap, ~2 sprints
- Partner integration only: +minimal infra, -limits self-serve, ~1 sprint
Devon Li: technical acceptance criteria proposal:
```
- 99th percentile latency <= 120ms for 512-dim embeddings
- Memory overhead < 15% per replica
- No more than 5% regressive cost per token
```
Sarah Gómez: Customer ask prioritization: Deal A (potential $1.2M ARR) requires streaming embeddings + SLA; Deal B (pilot) is lower priority. Recommend gating parity on Deal A closing.
Maria Chen: Good. Let's capture product acceptance criteria too: console progress, billing clarity, docs + migration guide, and canary rollout to Dedicated customers first.
roadmap-bot: New action created: "parity-vs-differentiate spike" assigned to Devon, due 2w from 1849123456. Link: https://redwood.internal/r/12345
Albert Novak: also suggest a design A/B: streaming indicator + fallback info. Minimal copy changes.
Maria Chen: Decisions for sprint planning:
- Approve 2-week spike (Devon)
- Chris to draft infra estimate for planning
- Sarah to prioritize customer gating
- Product to write launch criteria doc
Anyone object? :thumbsup:
Chris Patel: +1
Devon Li: +1
Sarah Gómez: +1
Albert Novak: +1
Maria Chen: I'll create the follow-up doc and link in this thread. Thanks all.
